why.description: First the reasoning: two to four sentences on how the code loses or doubles the data the evidence shows, naming the lines that do it.

summary.description: Then the fix in one sentence, such as: record the event's ID in the same transaction and skip one seen before.

file.description: The file to change, as the code shows its path.

change.description: The change itself: the code as it should be (the changed method or lines, in the app's own style), or the configuration to set. Not a whole file.

risks.description: What the fix could break or what else it needs, such as a migration for a new unique constraint; empty if nothing.
